LEARN BY DOING

Tools for everyday tech

Use your own device, files, and links. Tool instructions are in English.

Check my microphone

Allow microphone access, then speak. The meter shows the signal on this device without recording or sending audio.

Preview a screen or window

Choose a window or tab in your browser’s picker. The preview stays on this page. Close anything private before starting.

Open my Zoom or Google Meet

Paste the meeting invitation from someone you trust. We will open the actual meeting service in a new tab; its own interface handles joining.

A link opening is not a successful meeting join. Check camera and microphone in the service's preview.

Zoom helpGoogle Meet help

Rename a file copy

Choose a real file on your device. Enter a new base name and download a copy with the same file extension and contents. The original is not modified.

Share a PDF with someone

Choose your own PDF, then use your device's sharing menu if it supports file sharing. Otherwise, download or locate the original and attach it in your messaging app.

Only a user-selected file goes to the device's share menu. Samajh does not upload it or verify delivery.

Copy a link

Paste an HTTPS link that you intend to share. Copying does not grant access. Use your service's sharing settings to choose the correct recipient.

Google Drive sharing instructions

Changes inside Zoom, Meet or Drive happen in those apps. Samajh opens or guides you to the right service.
